== Possibly faulty data: Uniqueness marker on the Block 3 sheet ==
[[File:VB3-106-Ke_Chu_Ke_Kukuta.png|thumb|The Block 3 slip retained on the card article.]]
The published Block 3 sheet has no uniqueness bullet in the heading above Ke Chu Ke Kukuta?, but its lower black caption includes one. The original [[Ke Chu Ke Kukuta?]] is unrestricted, and the current virtual article also records Unrestricted. These conflicting labels do not establish a dated change of uniqueness. The provisional GEMP implementation preserves unrestricted, following the original host and the outer heading. A later dated correction explicitly making the card unique would settle this conflict; the caption alone has not been treated as a separate confirmed errata version.
